summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Amana Equity Income ETF (AMEI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed portfolio of dividend-paying stocks globally, of companies considered to be compliant with Islamic principles. The ETF seeks to provide current income. AMEI was launched on Jun 24, 2026 and is issued by Amana.

holdings.infoBox: AMEI is an equity ETF with a total of 32 individual holdings. The top holdings are Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company stock at 11.01%, Eli Lilly and Company at 10.38%, Microsoft at 6.98%, Us Dollars at 5.67%, and Rockwell Automation at 5.36%.
